title: Extend a linear map with a prescribed value outside its domain
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $V,U$ be $k$-vector spaces, let $P\subseteq V$ be a $k$-linear subspace, let $f:P\to U$ be $k$-linear, let $v\in V\setminus P$, and let $u\in U$. There exists a $k$-linear map $g:V\to U$ with $g|_P=f$ and $g(v)=u$.
